13	/-!
14	# Relative projective space `ℙ(n; S)`
15	
16	Mathlib v4.31 has the absolute `Proj` of a ℕ-graded ring together with the
17	properness package for `Proj.toSpecZero` (`ProjectiveSpectrum/Proper.lean`),
18	but no relative projective space over an arbitrary base scheme.  Following the
19	`AffineSpace` pattern (`Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/AffineSpace.lean`) and the
20	encoding settled in inbox `I-0118` (comment `C-0002`), this file defines
21	
22	* `AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace n S` (notation `ℙ(n; S)`): the relative
23	  projective space with homogeneous coordinates indexed by `n : Type u`, i.e.
24	  the pullback of the integral model
25	  `Proj ℤ[Xᵢ : i ∈ n] = Proj (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule n (ULift ℤ))`
26	  along `S ⟶ ⊤_ Scheme`;
27	* the structural morphism `ℙ(n; S) ↘ S` (a `CanonicallyOver` instance) with
28	  `IsProper` (hence `IsSeparated`, `UniversallyClosed`, `LocallyOfFiniteType`,
29	  `QuasiCompact`) derived by base change from the Mathlib instances on
30	  `Proj.toSpecZero`;
31	* functoriality `ProjectiveSpace.map` in the base and the base-change square
32	  `ProjectiveSpace.isPullback_map`.
33	
34	The key observations making the transfer work: the degree-zero part of the
35	homogeneous coordinate ring is the copy of `ULift ℤ` given by the constants
36	(`MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule_zero`), so `Spec (𝒜 0)` is terminal and
37	`terminal.from (Proj 𝒜)` factors as `Proj.toSpecZero 𝒜` followed by an
38	isomorphism; and for finitely many variables the coordinate ring is of finite
39	type over its degree-zero part, which is exactly the hypothesis of the Mathlib
40	properness instances.
41	
42	Blueprint: `def:projective_space`, `lem:projective_space_proper`
43	(`blueprint/src/chapters/Picard_QuotScheme.tex`).
44	-/
45	
46	open CategoryTheory Limits MvPolynomial
47	
48	noncomputable section
49	
50	namespace AlgebraicGeometry
51	
52	universe u
53	
54	/-- The total-degree grading on the homogeneous coordinate ring
55	`ℤ[Xᵢ : i ∈ n]` of the integral model of projective space (with `ULift ℤ`
56	coefficients for universe polymorphism, as in `AffineSpace`). -/
57	local notation3 "𝒫[" n "]" => homogeneousSubmodule n (ULift ℤ)
58	
59	/-- The total-degree grading is a graded ring structure.  Mathlib deliberately
60	does not register `MvPolynomial.gradedAlgebra` as a global instance (other
61	weightings of the same polynomial ring exist); for the fixed homogeneous
62	coordinate ring of projective space we register it project-wide. -/
63	instance (n : Type u) : GradedRing 𝒫[n] :=
64	  MvPolynomial.gradedAlgebra
65	
66	variable (n : Type u) (S : Scheme.{u})
67	
68	/-- `ℙ(n; S)` is the projective space over `S` with homogeneous coordinates
69	indexed by `n : Type u` (e.g. `ULift (Fin (m + 1))` for `ℙ^m_S`).  It is the
70	base change to `S` of the integral model `Proj ℤ[Xᵢ : i ∈ n]`. -/
71	def ProjectiveSpace (n : Type u) (S : Scheme.{u}) : Scheme.{u} :=
72	  pullback (terminal.from S)
73	    (terminal.from (Proj (homogeneousSubmodule n (ULift.{u} ℤ))))
74	
75	namespace ProjectiveSpace
76	
77	/-- `ℙ(n; S)` is the projective `n`-space over `S`. -/
78	scoped[AlgebraicGeometry] notation "ℙ(" n "; " S ")" => ProjectiveSpace n S
79	
80	instance canonicallyOver : (ℙ(n; S)).CanonicallyOver S where
81	  hom := pullback.fst _ _
82	
83	lemma over_eq_fst : ℙ(n; S) ↘ S = pullback.fst _ _ := rfl
84	
85	/-- The projection from `ℙ(n; S)` to the integral model `Proj ℤ[Xᵢ : i ∈ n]`. -/
86	def toProjInt : ℙ(n; S) ⟶ Proj 𝒫[n] := pullback.snd _ _
87	
88	lemma toProjInt_eq_snd : toProjInt n S = pullback.snd _ _ := rfl
89	
90	@[reassoc]
91	lemma over_terminal_comp :
92	    (ℙ(n; S) ↘ S) ≫ terminal.from S = toProjInt n S ≫ terminal.from (Proj 𝒫[n]) :=
93	  pullback.condition
94	
95	section GradeZero
96	
97	/-- The degree-zero part of the homogeneous coordinate ring is the copy of
98	`ULift ℤ` given by the constants. -/
99	lemma bijective_algebraMap_gradeZero :
100	    Function.Bijective
101	      (algebraMap (ULift.{u} ℤ) (homogeneousSubmodule n (ULift.{u} ℤ) 0)) := by
102	  constructor
103	  · intro a b hab
104	    have := congrArg Subtype.val hab
105	    simpa using MvPolynomial.C_injective n (ULift.{u} ℤ) this
106	  · intro x
107	    obtain ⟨y, hy⟩ := Submodule.mem_one.mp
108	      ((MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule_zero (σ := n) (R := ULift.{u} ℤ)).le x.2)
109	    exact ⟨y, Subtype.ext (by simpa using hy)⟩
110	
111	/-- The degree-zero part of the homogeneous coordinate ring, as a ring, is
112	`ULift ℤ`. -/
113	def gradeZeroRingEquiv :
114	    ULift.{u} ℤ ≃+* homogeneousSubmodule n (ULift.{u} ℤ) 0 :=
115	  RingEquiv.ofBijective
116	    (algebraMap (ULift.{u} ℤ) (homogeneousSubmodule n (ULift.{u} ℤ) 0))
117	    (bijective_algebraMap_gradeZero n)
118	
119	/-- `Spec` of the degree-zero part of the homogeneous coordinate ring is a
120	terminal scheme. -/
121	def specGradeZeroIsTerminal :
122	    IsTerminal (Spec (.of (homogeneousSubmodule n (ULift.{u} ℤ) 0))) :=
123	  specULiftZIsTerminal.{u}.ofIso
124	    (Scheme.Spec.mapIso (gradeZeroRingEquiv n).toCommRingCatIso.op).symm
125	
126	instance :
127	    IsIso (terminal.from (Spec (.of (homogeneousSubmodule n (ULift.{u} ℤ) 0)))) :=
128	  isIso_of_isTerminal (specGradeZeroIsTerminal n) terminalIsTerminal _
129	
130	/-- For finitely many variables, the homogeneous coordinate ring is of finite

8	/-!
9	# The projective line over a field, with usable charts
10	
11	We define `AlgebraicGeometry.P1 k` as `Proj` of the standard graded polynomial ring
12	`k[X₀, X₁]` (`MvPolynomial (Fin 2) k` with the degree grading), together with:
13	
14	* `P1.structureMap : P1 k ⟶ Spec (.of k)`, and the instance `IsProper (P1.structureMap k)`
15	  (inherited from mathlib's properness of `Proj`);
16	* the two standard affine charts `D₊(X₀)`, `D₊(X₁)` (`P1.chartOpen`), which cover `P1 k`
17	  (`P1.chartOpen_sup`), together with the open immersions `P1.chartι i` from the affine
18	  models `Spec (k[X₀,X₁]_(Xᵢ))₀`;
19	* identifications of the chart section rings with polynomial rings:
20	  `P1.awayAlgEquiv : (k[X₀,X₁]_(Xᵢ))₀ ≃ₐ[k] k[t]` (the coordinate is `t = Xⱼ/Xᵢ`).
21	
22	The identification of the chart *overlap* with Laurent polynomials, the section-level
23	versions, and the bundled chart package `AlgebraicGeometry.LaurentChartPair` are in the
24	continuation file `AlgebraicJacobian.Curve.P1Charts`.
25	
26	The generic instance `Algebra R (HomogeneousLocalization 𝒜 x)` (for a graded `R`-algebra) and
27	the lemma `LaurentPolynomial.exists_toLaurent_add_aeval` (*Laurent span*: every Laurent
28	polynomial is the sum of a polynomial in `T` and a polynomial in `T⁻¹`) are general-purpose
29	and live in their natural namespaces.
30	
31	## Implementation notes
32	
33	We install `MvPolynomial.gradedAlgebra` as a (project-global) instance: everywhere in this
34	project, `MvPolynomial` carries the standard degree grading. Mathlib leaves this to the user
35	because other gradings exist; this project only ever uses the standard one.
36	-/

15	
16	Mathlib v4.31 has the absolute `Proj` of a ℕ-graded ring together with the
17	properness package for `Proj.toSpecZero` (`ProjectiveSpectrum/Proper.lean`),
18	but no relative projective space over an arbitrary base scheme.  Following the
19	`AffineSpace` pattern (`Mathlib/AlgebraicGeometry/AffineSpace.lean`) and the
20	encoding settled in inbox `I-0118` (comment `C-0002`), this file defines
21	
22	* `AlgebraicGeometry.ProjectiveSpace n S` (notation `ℙ(n; S)`): the relative
23	  projective space with homogeneous coordinates indexed by `n : Type u`, i.e.
24	  the pullback of the integral model
25	  `Proj ℤ[Xᵢ : i ∈ n] = Proj (MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule n (ULift ℤ))`
26	  along `S ⟶ ⊤_ Scheme`;
27	* the structural morphism `ℙ(n; S) ↘ S` (a `CanonicallyOver` instance) with
28	  `IsProper` (hence `IsSeparated`, `UniversallyClosed`, `LocallyOfFiniteType`,
29	  `QuasiCompact`) derived by base change from the Mathlib instances on
30	  `Proj.toSpecZero`;
31	* functoriality `ProjectiveSpace.map` in the base and the base-change square
32	  `ProjectiveSpace.isPullback_map`.

35	homogeneous coordinate ring is the copy of `ULift ℤ` given by the constants
36	(`MvPolynomial.homogeneousSubmodule_zero`), so `Spec (𝒜 0)` is terminal and
37	`terminal.from (Proj 𝒜)` factors as `Proj.toSpecZero 𝒜` followed by an
38	isomorphism; and for finitely many variables the coordinate ring is of finite
39	type over its degree-zero part, which is exactly the hypothesis of the Mathlib
40	properness instances.

164	/-! ## The chart-ring span core (the `ℤ[X₁/X₀]` computation)
165	
166	The mathematical heart of `span_pow_x`: every element of the degree-zero away ring
167	`(ℤ[X₀,X₁]_{X₀})₀` is a `(𝒜 0)`-combination of the powers of the coordinate fraction
168	`X₁/X₀`.  The key algebraic step is that a degree-`(a+b)` monomial fraction
169	`X₀^a X₁^b / X₀^(a+b)` equals `(X₁/X₀)^b`. -/

173	/-- The pure monomial identity `(x₀¹)ᵇ (x₀ᵃ x₁ᵇ) = x₀^(a+b) x₁ᵇ`, proved in a generic
174	commutative monoid so the certificate never touches the expensive `MvPolynomial`
175	`ring` normalisation. -/
176	private lemma pow_mul_pow_identity {A : Type*} [CommMonoid A] (x0 x1 : A) (a b : ℕ) :
177	    (x0 ^ 1) ^ b * (x0 ^ a * x1 ^ b) = x0 ^ (a + b) * x1 ^ b := by
178	  rw [pow_one, ← mul_assoc, ← pow_add, Nat.add_comm b a]
179	
180	/-- The degree-`(a+b)` monomial fraction `X₀^a X₁^b / X₀^(a+b)` as an element of the
181	degree-zero away ring `(ℤ[X]_{X₀})₀`.  (Isolating the `Away.mk` inside a definition,
182	with the homogeneity obligation discharged by a `by`-block rather than a pre-typed
183	term, keeps the concrete graded-instance `isDefEq` from blowing up — cf. `p1CoordAway`.) -/
184	noncomputable def p1Monomial (a b : ℕ) :
185	    Away (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ)) (X ⟨0⟩) :=
186	  Away.mk _ (ProjTwist.X_mem_deg_one (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) ⟨0⟩) (a + b)
187	    (X ⟨0⟩ ^ a * X ⟨1⟩ ^ b)
188	    (by
189	      rw [add_smul]
190	      exact SetLike.mul_mem_graded
191	        (SetLike.pow_mem_graded a (ProjTwist.X_mem_deg_one (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) ⟨0⟩))
192	        (SetLike.pow_mem_graded b (ProjTwist.X_mem_deg_one (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) ⟨1⟩)))
193

195	`X₀^a X₁^b / X₀^(a+b)` in `(ℤ[X]_{X₀})₀` equals `(X₁/X₀)^b`, the `b`-th power of the
196	coordinate fraction.  This is the per-monomial step of the chart-ring spanning
197	`Γ(V₀) = k[X₁/X₀]`. -/

199	    p1Monomial a b = p1CoordAway (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) ⟨0⟩ ⟨1⟩ ^ b := by
200	  apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
201	  rw [HomogeneousLocalization.val_pow]
202	  simp only [p1Monomial, p1CoordAway, Away.val_mk, Localization.mk_pow]
203	  rw [Localization.mk_eq_mk_iff, Localization.r_iff_exists]
204	  refine ⟨1, ?_⟩
205	  simp only [OneMemClass.coe_one, one_mul, SubmonoidClass.coe_pow]
206	  exact pow_mul_pow_identity _ _ a b

208	/-- Two-variable monomial expansion: the monomial `X^d · c` in `ℤ[X₀, X₁]` is
209	`c · X₀^{d₀} · X₁^{d₁}` (`Finsupp.prod` over the two-element index reduced with
210	`Fin.prod_univ_two` through the `ULift (Fin 2) ≃ Fin 2` equivalence). -/

215	  congr 1

217	        (fun i => X i ^ d i), Fin.prod_univ_two]
218	  rfl

221	degree-`N` monomial fraction `(monomial d c)/X₀^N` (with `d₀ + d₁ = N`) equals the

239	    have hfz : (HomogeneousLocalization.fromZeroRingHom

241	        (Submonoid.powers (X ⟨0⟩)) ⟨C c, hC0⟩).val
242	        = Localization.mk (C c) 1 := rfl
243	    rw [Algebra.smul_def, HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_eq,

302	    apply HomogeneousLocalization.val_injective
303	    rw [Away.val_mk, ← HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply, map_sum]
304	    simp only [HomogeneousLocalization.algebraMap_apply, Away.val_mk]
305	    rw [← Localization.mk_sum, ← MvPolynomial.as_sum]
306	  rw [hsum]

400	/-! ## Transporting the span core through a ring hom (route step 2, algebraic heart)
401	
402	The char-free "push the `ℤ`-span through `k ⊗_ℤ (−)`".  For **any** ring hom `ρ`
403	from the degree-zero away ring `(ℤ[X₀,X₁]_{X₀})₀` into a `k`-algebra `B`, the image
404	`ρ a` of every away element lies in the `k`-span of the powers of `ρ (X₁/X₀)`.  The
405	`(𝒜 0) = ℤ`-scalars of the span core (`span_p1CoordAway_pow_top`) become `k`-scalars
406	because a ring hom sends integer constants of `𝒜 0` to integers of `B`, which are
407	`k`-multiples of `1`.  Applied to the pullback ring map `Away 𝒜 X₀ → Γ(V₀)` (whose
408	value at `X₁/X₀` is the chart coordinate `x`), this is exactly the transport of the
409	span through the tensor identification `Γ(V₀) = k ⊗_ℤ (ℤ[X₁/X₀])`. -/
410	
411	section SpanTransport
412	
413	variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
414	
415	/-- Every element of the degree-zero part `𝒜 0` (the copy of `ℤ` given by the
416	constants) is an integer constant. -/
417	private lemma exists_intCast_eq_gradeZero
418	    (c : (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ) 0)) :
419	    ∃ m : ℤ, (m : (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ) 0)) = c := by
420	  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ :=
421	    (ProjectiveSpace.bijective_algebraMap_gradeZero (ULift.{u} (Fin 2))).surjective c
422	  refine ⟨z.down, ?_⟩
423	  rw [← hz, ← map_intCast (algebraMap (ULift.{u} ℤ)
424	    (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ) 0)) z.down]
425	  rfl
426	
427	/-- **Route step 2, algebraic core: transport of the span through a ring hom.**
428	For any ring hom `ρ` from the degree-zero away ring `(ℤ[X₀,X₁]_{X₀})₀` into a
429	`k`-algebra `B`, the image `ρ a` of every away element lies in the `k`-span of the
430	powers of `ρ (X₁/X₀)`. -/
431	lemma awayRingHom_mem_span_pow {B : Type u} [CommRing B] [Algebra k B]
432	    (ρ : Away (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ)) (X ⟨0⟩) →+* B)
433	    (a : Away (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ)) (X ⟨0⟩)) :
434	    ρ a ∈ Submodule.span k
435	      (Set.range fun m : ℕ => ρ (p1CoordAway (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) ⟨0⟩ ⟨1⟩) ^ m) := by
436	  have hmem : a ∈ Submodule.span (homogeneousSubmodule (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) (ULift.{u} ℤ) 0)
437	      (Set.range fun m : ℕ => p1CoordAway (ULift.{u} (Fin 2)) ⟨0⟩ ⟨1⟩ ^ m) :=
438	    span_p1CoordAway_pow_top (Submodule.mem_top)
439	  induction hmem using Submodule.span_induction with
440	  | mem z hz =>
441	      obtain ⟨m, rfl⟩ := hz
